title: Water Damage Mitigation Compliance Bulletin: Lead-Safe Setup and Asbestos Sampling
content:
**Compliance bulletin — Water Damage Mitigation regulated materials**

Lead-safe setup is billable only when the building was built before the RRP year-built cutoff and the work disturbs more interior painted surface in a room than the RRP interior threshold. This follows the EPA Renovation, Repair and Painting Rule, which applies lead-safe work practices to pre-1978 housing and child-occupied facilities when painted surfaces are disturbed beyond its minor repair and maintenance threshold, and lead-safe work is performed only by the company's EPA-certified renovators. Asbestos sampling is billable only when the building was built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff. Under company policy such a building is sampled before any flood cut, drywall or texture tear-out, and no flood cut line may be billed on that job with a service date earlier than the asbestos sampling line. Lead-safe setup and asbestos sampling are each billed once per job.

## Evidence
The year the building was built is read from the job record; both tests use that recorded year, and the cutoffs and the interior threshold are the tier's own figures.

## Lead-safe setup: condition table (hypothetical rooms, threshold taken as the tier's RRP interior threshold)
| Building built before the RRP cutoff? | Painted surface disturbed in a room | Lead-safe setup billable? |
|---|---|---|
| yes | more than the threshold | yes |
| yes | exactly the threshold or less | no |
| no | any amount | no |

## Asbestos sampling and flood cuts
- Built before the asbestos sampling year cutoff: asbestos sampling is billable, once per job, and no flood cut line on that job may carry a service date earlier than the asbestos sampling line.
- Built in or after that cutoff year: asbestos sampling is not billable.

## Illustration (hypothetical)
A building recorded as built in the cutoff year itself is not built before the cutoff, so the corresponding service is not billable on that test; a building recorded one year earlier is.
